text: The system shall start each part of the platform when the host starts.
The system shall start again each part that stops.
rationale: REQ-PL-038. A part that runs and answers nothing has not stopped in the sense of this row.

text: The system shall start again a part that stops within TBD of the time that it stopped, other than a part that REQ-HO-018 holds to a longer wait.
rationale: REQ-PL-038. A part in a loop waits longer under REQ-HO-018, so this value bounds the start of a part that stops once. The value is TBD (rule 13).

text: The system shall refuse a connection to a destination outside the host from each part other than those of External Access.
rationale: REQ-PL-033 and OPN-095. External Access holds each part that opens a connection to an external service (DEC-161). The row names a destination and not a service, because what refuses sees a destination and not a service.

text: The system shall refuse to each part a read and a write of the storage of another part.
rationale: REQ-PL-024. Each system refuses by position at its own boundary, and a part that reads the storage of another passes that boundary. DEC-130 gives no agent the files of the host.

text: The system shall refuse each connection from outside the host to a part, other than a connection that the host routes to Interaction or to External Access.
rationale: REQ-PL-024. Interaction carries the user (DEC-143) and External Access accepts a delivery (DEC-129). A part that is reachable from outside the host is reached past each position, and a connection that does not pass the routing of the host is not encrypted by it (INT-PL-136, INT-PL-137).

text: The system shall not give a part the authority to change the network, the storage or the allocation that the system holds it to.
rationale: A part that can change its own fence is not fenced, and REQ-HO-004, REQ-HO-005, REQ-HO-006, REQ-HO-009 and REQ-HO-010 then hold only for a part that does not try. DEC-178.

text: The system shall reserve TBD of the storage that the host gives the platform, for the platform to start, to make its copy away from the host and to start on a new version.
rationale: DEC-179. The host can hold other work, so the system cannot keep the storage of the host free, and it reserves part of what the platform is given. When the data of the platform fills the rest, the platform still starts (REQ-PL-038), makes its copy (REQ-PL-022) and starts on a new version (REQ-PL-041).

text: The system shall hold each part within the memory allocated to it.
rationale: DEC-179. The allocation is configuration of the instance, at or above the budget of REQ-PL-039. A part that passes it stops, and REQ-HO-002 starts it again, in place of a stop of the parts around it.

text: The system shall hold each part within the storage allocated to it.
rationale: DEC-179. A part that fills the storage stops the writes of each other part.

text: The system shall report each part that it starts again.
rationale: A part that stops after each start looks healthy to a check of whether it runs.

text: The system shall give Self-Observation, at an interval of TBD, the memory and the storage that each part uses.
rationale: A part that reaches its memory stops at once, so a report of the stop comes too late. Self-Observation holds a threshold for each measure (DEC-166) and raises the work before the limit. INT-PL-133.

text: The system shall give Self-Observation each fact that it reports.
rationale: DEC-162. The facts are those of REQ-HO-011 and REQ-HO-017. INT-PL-132.

text: The system shall start again a part that does not answer a check within TBD.
rationale: RSK-HO-001. A part that runs and answers nothing has not stopped, so REQ-HO-002 does not start it again.

text: The system shall report, at an interval of TBD, each part other than those of External Access that can reach a destination outside the host.
rationale: RSK-HO-003. A test verifies REQ-HO-004 for the parts that existed when it ran, and a part that a new version adds was not tested. A runtime gives a part a route to outside by default.

text: The system shall wait longer before each start of a part that stopped within TBD of its last start than it waited before that last start, up to a wait of TBD, and shall return to the first wait when the part runs for TBD.
rationale: DEC-184 and RSK-HO-006. A part in a loop that starts again at once adds a fact at each start (REQ-HO-011), and nothing removes the facts. A wait that grows with each start is standard practice for a supervisor of processes. A part that stops once still starts again at once, and a part that recovers loses the longer wait. The values are TBD (rule 13).
